summary: Restoration verification of ClanChat auth + admin + feed after Supabase re-linking. Ran 10 backend pytest tests (all PASS) and 4 end-to-end Playwright UI flows (all PASS). Login (admin+bob), registration, admin panel, and feed all work; Supabase-first-then-legacy fallback is functioning; no runtime error overlay; no 'Supabase config unavailable' message.

UI: admin login lands on /feed, shows 'Welcome back', Admin nav link present, /admin renders moderation panel (Reports/CSAM/Watchlist tabs, stats)

Frontend logs a 400 from Supabase on every legacy-fallback login (expected by design). Consider suppressing the console.error for cleaner devtools UX.
